scope: Metadata provenance branch; actual local CPU fixtures, no natural-data validation or human ratings.

user_data_branch.estimand: Descriptive paired event counts against user-supplied unverified references; not population quality
user_data_branch.normal_scope: successful fully decoded clips with empty user-supplied references; reference completeness unverified
limits: User-supplied references and source groups are unverified; not independent sampling proof.
Raw stillness cannot distinguish an intentional still shot from a defect.
Frozen cut guard can suppress real flashes near a cut; those misses remain counted.
Failed clips remain in planned denominator and are excluded from conditional event metrics.
The v2 matching protocol differs from v1 greedy matching; historical scores must not be merged.

test_data_note: The user_data branch probe copies a small controlled fixture and changes its nature declaration; it is a branch test, not a new natural-data or human study.
